name: Snowflake
sku: Snowflake Standard edition. Capability that needs the Enterprise edition carries an enterprise-tier constraint, and Business Critical features are not scored. Cortex AI services and Snowpark Container Services are not scored, so derived coverage may understate the platform.

presentation.tagline: Cloud data platform: warehouse, ingestion, governance, ML and apps under one contract.

cost.note: Standard edition, AWS US East, on-demand: $2.00/credit, storage $23/TB/month (~$0.0225/GB; capacity contracts cut 20-45%, not modeled). Snowflake's real driver is warehouse compute, not stored volume, so each point assumes a plausible warehouse size and monthly run-hours for a pipeline moving that much data (X-Small ~20hr/month at 10GB, up to 2X-Large ~300hr/month at 1PB) — stated per point, not billed at a flat rate.
